question: Why does meditation fail to produce results when it is mixed with doubt?
premises: Meditation tainted by doubt does not bear fruit.
Doubt involves grasping two opposing alternatives.
inference: Therefore efficacy depends on undivided firmness of consciousness, not on conception as such.
plain_english: Meditation is precisely firmness of conception; but meditation tainted by doubt does not bear fruit at all, because it grasps two alternatives.
